dialogue:
[patient] hi its deb, typing for my dad. pt: PARKINSON, WALTER  dob 03/14/1934  mrn 00483291. he's 92 now and still stubborn as a mule 🙄
[nurse] Hi Deb, this is Renee, RN with Dr. Abernathy's team at Olentangy Valley Neurology. Thanks for sending his info. What's going on with Mr. Parkinson today?
[patient] his parkinsons is worse since the carbidopa/levodopa change on 9/22. the shaking is more in his right hand and hes shuffling alot more. also no BM for like 5 days 😬
[nurse] Okay. Is he still taking the 25/100 tablets, 1.5 tabs three times a day like Dr. Abernathy ordered?
[patient] yes 1 and a half at 7 11 and 3. sometimes the 3pm one is late bc he naps
[nurse] Got it. Any falls, new confusion, or seeing things that aren't there?
[patient] no falls thank god. bit foggy in the evenings. the home health girl did the clock test tuesday and he got 3/5, she said same as last time
[nurse] Good, that sounds stable. Parkinson's meds and the disease itself can slow the gut down. Any belly pain, vomiting, or blood in the stool?
[patient] no pain no vomiting. he drinks maybe 3 glasses of water a day, rest is coffee ☕ he was a machinist at harmon tool & die for 40 yrs and still thinks coffee counts as water haha
[nurse] 😄 Classic. Start MiraLAX 17 g in 8 oz of fluid once a day and aim for 6-8 cups of water. If no BM in 48 hrs, or any belly pain or vomiting, call us at (614) 555-0187 or go to the ER.
[patient] ok. also can walt be seen sooner than nov 18?? i can bring him any day but fri, i work at the westerville library
[nurse] I have Thursday 10/29/2026 at 1:40 pm at our Polaris office, 8250 Lazelle Crossing Rd, Suite 210, Columbus OH 43240. Does that work?
[patient] yes perfect 🙏 pls send the reminder to deb.okafor62@gmail.com not his old email, he never checks it
[nurse] Updated. Please bring his BP log too. In clinic he was 132/78 sitting and 104/66 standing, so have him get up slowly.
[patient] will do. his neighbor mr hill walks with him up the hill to the mailbox every morning so hes not alone 👍
[nurse] That's great. Have him take it slow on that hill. See you Thursday!
note:
PORTAL MESSAGE ENCOUNTER - Olentangy Valley Neurology

Date: 10/16/2026
Contact: daughter Debra Parkinson-Okafor (HCPOA), cell 614-555-0122

92-year-old man with Parkinson's disease, Hoehn and Yahr stage 3, on carbidopa/levodopa 25/100, 1.5 tablets TID since dose change on 9/22/2026. No bowel movement for 5 days; no abdominal pain, vomiting or hematochezia. Poor fluid intake. Retired machinist, lives alone; neighbor checks on him daily.

VITALS (last clinic visit)
BP 132/78 sitting, 104/66 standing.

ASSESSMENT
1. Parkinson's disease without dyskinesia, without fluctuations; tremor worse after recent dose change.
2. Constipation, likely related to Parkinson's and low fluid intake.
3. Orthostatic hypotension.

PLAN
- Polyethylene glycol 17 g daily; fluids 6-8 cups/day. ER/return precautions reviewed.
- Follow-up moved up to 10/29/2026 with Dr. Lorraine Abernathy (NPI 1649382057), Polaris office.
- Rise slowly from sitting; fall precautions.
- Contact email updated per daughter.

Renee Szymańska, RN

dialogue:
[nurse] Hi Siobhán, this is Aoife, practice nurse at Ballyknock Medical Centre. Dr Hill asked me to check in after your visit to the Kilcroney Injury Unit at the weekend. How's the ankle?
[patient] hiya aoife!! its siobhan ni bhriain, dob 03/11/1987 in case ye need it. ankle still the size of a melon 🍈😭 pain is about 7/10 when i stand on it, maybe 3/10 lying down with it up
[nurse] Oh no! Can you take a few steps on it? Any numbness or tingling in the foot or toes?
[patient] i can hobble like 4 steps ya. no numbness. toes are purple-ish but warm. the doctor in kilcroney did the ottawa ankle rules thing and said no xray needed, grade 2 sprain she reckons
[nurse] Ok good. And just so I have it right for the notes - how did it happen?
[patient] hillwalking on djouce with my friend gráinne on sat 10th oct. i slipped on a wet rock coming down and went over on my right ankle 🙄 tell dr hill i was literally walking up a hill like he keeps telling me to 😂 just the coming down part went wrong lol
[nurse] 😂 I'll pass that on! Keep doing RICE - rest, ice 20 mins every 2-3 hrs, compression, elevation. Ibuprofen 400mg three times a day with food for 3/7, plus paracetamol 1g if needed. Are you on any other meds?
[patient] just the pill (microgynon) and my blue inhaler
[nurse] Ibuprofen can sometimes make asthma worse, so if you get wheezy stop it and stick with the paracetamol.
[patient] grand. also i need a sick cert for work, im a barista at kavanaghs cafe in greystones and im on my feet 8 hrs, no way i can do it. my manager is tom ryan if they ring
[nurse] No problem, Dr Hill will do a cert for 1 week. You can download the form from www.ballyknockmc.ie/certs or collect it at reception. Is your address still 14 Cois Abhann, Kilcoole, A63 FX27?
[patient] yep same. and mobile is 087 555 3921, PPS 8273615WA if the cert needs it
[nurse] Perfect. Review with Dr Hill in 2/52 (thats 2 weeks!) - booked for Tues 27/10 at 10.15. Ring (01) 555 2840 if the pain gets worse, the calf goes swollen/red or you can't weight bear at all.
[patient] legend thanks a mil aoife ❤️ shiv x

dialogue:
[doctor] Hi, this is Dr. Graves from Sac Valley Endocrine & Thyroid. Your labs from 10/14 are back. Is this Thao? Please confirm your DOB.
[patient] hi yes its me THAO NGUYEN-BAPTISTE lol, dob 7-22-79. was hoping u would text 😅
[doctor] Thanks! Your TSH is still <0.01 and free T4 went up to 3.4 (normal 0.8-1.8). Accession QL26-1014-44731 if you want to see it in the portal. How are you feeling?
[patient] honestly not great. heart is racing at night, my watch said 118 resting last night 💓 and my hands shake when im writing on the whiteboard, my 2nd graders think its funny lol
[doctor] Any chest pain, fainting, or shortness of breath?
[patient] no chest pain. little winded on stairs. lost like 9 lbs since sept without trying
[doctor] Are you taking the methimazole 10 mg every day? It's ok if you've missed some, I just need to know.
[patient] ...missed a few 🙈 school started aug 12 and my mornings are chaos. my husband marcus puts it next to the coffee maker now
[doctor] That helps a lot. Your Graves' disease is clearly not controlled yet. Plan: methimazole 20 mg daily (two 10s), and add propranolol 10 mg, 1/2 to 1 tab up to 3x/day for the racing heart. Hold it if your HR is under 60 or you feel dizzy.
[patient] ok. my mom has graves disease too, she had the radioactive iodine. will i need that??
[doctor] Maybe down the line, we'll go over options at your visit. Your BP at the last visit was 142/88, so the propranolol should help that too.
[patient] can u fax a note to my work? rosewood elementary HR, fax (916) 555-0143, attn denise okoro-fitch. i might need a couple half days
[doctor] Yes, I'll fax it today. Please also upload your BP/HR log at https://portal.sacvalleyendo.com/upload when you can. Repeat labs (TSH, free T4, CBC, LFTs) in 4 wks - the order is in for 11/11/2026 at the Quest on Florin Rd.
[patient] ty dr graves!! also my email changed, its tnguyenbaptiste@yahoo.com 🙏 thx - tay
[doctor] Updated. Call 911 or go to the ER for chest pain or fainting. Take care, Thao!
